Please just make sure the laptop change is all set, and I’ll reach out again about the watch once it’s delivered. Thank you for helping me with both things, even if it couldn’t all be done together.
Thank you for your help and for being patient with me. I’ll wait for the watch to arrive and contact you again then. That’s all I needed for now.
